name: balseraphs_horseman
description: a Balseraph Horseman, a jester-knight in a steel helmet with a green-and-gold jester-cap plume tipped with gold bells, a black domino mask and auburn hair, a violet, gold and green diamond-motley tabard over steel mail with gold bells, a long steel-tipped spear with a violet-and-gold pennant in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side and a round violet-and-gold diamond shield with a steel boss on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side, riding a glossy black horse with an emerald saddle cloth patterned with gold diamonds and a brown bridle
hands: the pennant spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round violet-and-gold shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
